test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Constitution of India, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The Legislature is a small group of people.
The Executive refers to our elected representatives
The Legislature, Executive and the Judiciary should exercise same powers.
The Judiciary refers to the system of courts in the country.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The judiciary refers to the system of courts in the country.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Legislature is a group of people who vote for new laws, for example in a state or country.
 
• Each person in the legislature is usually either elected or appointed.
 
 
• **Hence, Option 1 is incorrect.**
 
 
 
• The executive consists of the President, Vice President and Council of Ministers, led by the Prime Minister.
 
 
• **Hence, Option 2 is incorrect.**
 
 
 
• The Legislature, Executive and the Judiciary Should exercise different powers in separate areas.** **
 
 
• **Hence, Option 3 is incorrect.**
 
 
 
• The Judiciary is that branch of the government that interprets the law, settles disputes and administers justice to all citizens. 
 
• The judiciary is considered the watchdog of democracy, and also the guardian of the constitution.
 
• For democracy to function effectively, it is imperative to have an impartial and independent judiciary.
 
 
• **Hence, Option 4 is correct.​**
